title: On Semiotic-Grounded Interpretive Evaluation of Generative Art
abstract: arXiv:2604.08641v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Interpretation is essential to deciphering the language of art: audiences communicate with artists by recovering meaning from visual artifacts. However, current Generative Art (GenArt) evaluators primarily emphasize surface-level image quality or literal prompt adherence, failing to assess the deeper symbolic or contextual meaning intended by the creator. We formalize this observation using Peircean computational semiotic theory that models Human-GenArt Interaction (HGI) as cascaded semiosis. This framework reveals that artistic meaning is conveyed through iconic, symbolic, and indexical modes, whereas appearance-centered evaluators tend to emphasize the iconic mode. Building on this account, we propose SemJudge, an interpretation-centric evaluation framework that uses a Hierarchical Semiosis Graph (HSG) to reconstruct meaning conveyance from prompt to generated artifact. translated_title: 基于符号学基础的生成艺术解释性评估研究
translated_abstract: 解释对于解读艺术语言至关重要：观众通过从视觉作品中还原意义来与艺术家进行交流。然而，当前的生成艺术评估器主要强调表面层次的图像质量或对提示词的字面遵循，无法评估创作者所意图表达的更深层次的象征性或语境性意义。我们利用皮尔士计算符号学理论将这一观察形式化，将人类-生成艺术交互建模为级联符号过程。该框架揭示出艺术意义是通过图像、象征和指涉三种模式传递的，而以外观为中心的评估器往往只强调图像模式。基于这一理论阐述，我们提出了SemJudge——一个以解释为中心的评估框架，它使用层次符号过程图来重建从提示词到生成作品的意义传递过程。在一个解释密集型基准上的实验……
tldr: 该论文基于皮尔士计算符号学理论提出SemJudge评估框架，通过层次符号过程图重建生成艺术从提示词到作品的意义传递过程，突破了现有评估器仅关注表面图像质量、忽视深层象征意义与语境意义的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SemJudge, an interpretation-centric evaluation framework grounded in Peircean computational semiotic theory, which uses a Hierarchical Semiosis Graph to reconstruct meaning conveyance from prompt to generated artifact, addressing the limitation of existing generative art evaluators that focus only on surface-level image quality rather than deeper symbolic and contextual meaning.
